items.claim: Hernandez has the durability to survive early finishing attempts from Rodriguez.
items.quote: I think his durability is good enough to survive that early onslaught.

items.claim: Hernandez possesses good cardio, a good ground game, and good stand-up.
items.quote: you know he's got good cardio and he's got a good ground game, good good stand-up.

items.claim: Hernandez trained at Extreme Culture with high-level partners like Sean Strickland, Roman Dolidze, and Mansour Abdul Malakh.
items.quote: Was working a bit at Extreme Couture which I think adds some bonus points there, too. With getting to work with guys like Sean Strickland and Roman Dolidze and you know, again, Mansour Abdul Malakh
Rodriguez is a little bit overhyped.

items.claim: Rodriguez gassed out in his fight against Jared Cannonier because he failed to put him away early.
items.quote: kind of gassed out in that one cuz part of it was he couldn't put Cannonier away early.
